description.value: Jac's On The Beach is a scratch-made beachfront kitchen and bar situated right on the water in Peachland, BC, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists touring the Okanagan lakefront. The menu leans on simplicity and quality with house-made dishes, local and international wines, draught beer, and crafted cocktails. The restaurant draws both locals and visitors with its lively atmosphere, Saturday Prime Rib nights, and daily happy hour.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms an active beachfront restaurant and bar at 5866B Beach Ave, Peachland BC, with matching phone number and consistent branding. The contact page explicitly mentions ordering for 'convenient pick-up', confirming takeout availability. No bike-specific amenities (parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those fields remain null. A notable discrepancy exists between OSM opening hours (open Monday, different times) and the website's stated hours (Tue–Sat 11am–7pm, Sun 9am–5pm, closed Monday).
concerns: OSM opening hours (Mo–Th 11:00–20:00; Fr 09:00–21:00; Sa 09:00–20:00; Su 09:00–17:00) conflict with website hours (Tue–Sat 11AM–7PM, Sun 9AM–5PM, closed Mondays). Website should be considered more current.
OSM formatted address omits unit 'B' (present in addr:unit tag); website lists '5866B Beach Ave', confirming the unit.
OSM tag 'was:name=Rocky J's Beach Hut' indicates a prior business name at this location; current branding is consistent with Jac's On The Beach.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible beachfront restaurant and bar in Peachland with a confirmed website and matching contact details — a useful stop for touring cyclists on the Okanagan lakefront.

wow_evidence: scratch-made beachfront kitchen and bar situated right on the water in Peachland
